lede: The Gold Mountain Fire — nearly 40,000 acres burned northeast of Ouray, Highway 550 cut off repeatedly — is front and center at the Ridgway Town Council meeting Wednesday, where the council will ratify a letter backing a federal Major Disaster Declaration. That same day, the San Miguel County BOCC holds a special meeting to consider Resolution 2026-34, which would adjust Area Median Income limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park — a small technical change with real consequences for who actually qualifies for local housing. Thursday, the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy.

notable.stake: Council ratifies Major Disaster Declaration support for Gold Mountain Fire communities.
